rules.name: TO DREAM A THOUSAND DEATHS
rules.text: Your Powers never cause Damage, nor can they Destroy anything other than your own [Presence] . When your Powers would Destroy (or deal enough Damage to Destroy) [Explorer] / [Town] / [City] , instead generate 0/2/5 [Fear] . The Power Pushes all [Explorer] / [Town] it would Destroy. Notes: A single Power cannot Destroy a given Invader more than once. Powers that cause Damage via [Dahan] are affected just like all others. All effects other than Damage/Destroy work as usual.
rules.turn:
use-power S P, spirit:special S dream-a-thousand-deaths, { destroy X => ~dream-destroy X }
use-power S P, spirit:special S dream-a-thousand-deaths, { damage-piece X N => ~dream-damage X N }
-- "(or deal enough Damage to Destroy)"
dream-damage X N, piece:kind X K, kind:health K H, ge N H, ~dream-destroy X
-- "instead generate 0/2/5 Fear"
dream-destroy X, piece:kind X K, dream-fear K F, +fear-from X F
-- "The Power Pushes all Explorer / Town it would Destroy."
-- (the exception RHS cannot mention the Spirit, so the pusher is looked up)
dream-destroy X, piece:kind X K, dream-pushes K, at X L,
  spirit:special S dream-a-thousand-deaths, ~push S X L
rules.evidence: with the rule: Town -> `fear-from *63 2`, `push bringer *63 l1`; Explorer dealt 1 Damage -> `fear-from *100 0`, pushed; Dahan -> dream-destroy only (not destroyed); total fear 2. Control without the rule: all three destroyed, fear 1
rules.notes: Maps very directly: two exceptions scoped to this Spirit's use-power episode replace destroy / damage-piece; 'or deal enough Damage to Destroy' falls out of checking Health inside the replacement. Own-Presence destruction is untouched because the base routes it through destroy-presence, not destroy. Missing: accumulated Damage across instructions (BASE-EXT is single-hit), 'a single Power cannot Destroy a given Invader more than once', Damage dealt by Dahan a Power moves (only matters once Powers can make Dahan deal Damage). The exception RHS may not mention the Spirit, so the push looks the Bringer up by its special-rule fact (would be ambiguous with two Bringers).

base_ext: Health (kind:health facts) and `damage-piece X N` that destroys when N >= Health (single-hit, no accumulated Damage).
language_issues: Exception RHS may only use the intercepted tuple's variables, so context (which Spirit's Power) must be re-derived in a helper rule; with two copies of a Spirit this would be ambiguous.
